dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.text: The first day of school always feels the same... until it doesn't.

dialogue.speaker: Kisetsu
dialogue.text: New classroom. New classmates. Hopefully a quiet year.

dialogue.speaker: Penny
dialogue.text: Hey! You're the transfer student, right?

dialogue.speaker: Penny
dialogue.text: Perfect! I need someone who isn't afraid of getting into trouble.

dialogue.speaker: Penny
dialogue.text: Good! That means you'll fit right in.

choices.text: I'm just trying to survive today.

dialogue.speaker: Penny
dialogue.text: Then surviving with company is better than surviving alone.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.text: The final bell rings. Classes are over.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.text: Where will you go?

dialogue.speaker: Penny
dialogue.text: Found you!

dialogue.speaker: Penny
dialogue.text: The school records skip an entire year.

dialogue.speaker: Kisetsu
dialogue.text: Maybe they were lost.

dialogue.speaker: Penny
dialogue.text: Or maybe somebody wanted them gone.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.text: The silence of the library suddenly feels heavier.

dialogue.speaker: Erika
dialogue.text: Welcome.

dialogue.speaker: Erika
dialogue.text: Student Council is preparing for this year's festival.

dialogue.speaker: Kisetsu
dialogue.text: Everyone keeps talking about that festival.

dialogue.speaker: Erika
dialogue.text: ...Because the last one ended before anyone could celebrate.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.text: Before you can ask what she means, another student calls her away.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.text: The hallway is unusually quiet.

dialogue.speaker: Kisetsu
dialogue.text: Can I help you?

dialogue.speaker: Yuri
dialogue.text: Don't trust rumors.

dialogue.speaker: Yuri
dialogue.text: Especially the ones Penny tells.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.text: Before you can answer, she's already gone.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.text: You leave school with more questions than answers.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.text: A missing year. A cancelled festival. Three students who all seem to know something.

dialogue.speaker: Kisetsu
dialogue.text: ...Maybe this year won't be so quiet after all.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.text: End of Day 1.
